scope: Finite valid-supply ideal event model and independent actual native XML gate/pin audit; artificial signals and loads only

assumptions.event_timer_and_gate_delay_model: Ideal instantaneous valid-supply state transitions; physical latencies separately declared by analog study

functional_audit.gate_pin_identity_source: Fixed package pins from primary component tables; actual KiCad XML net names

scenarios.title: Startup requires fresh heartbeat, pre-MON health, separate resets and raw rearm

checks.claim: no first heartbeat means no watchdog-good and no admission
pre-MON physical supervision becomes healthy independently of MON_PERMIT
source1 monitor still prevents RAW_HEALTH
both monitors restore raw health without implicitly arming
separate fault-reset then rearm establishes admission

limitations: SENSE_HEALTH -> old monitor EXT_SUP_OK; RAW_HEALTH/ARM-qualified EXT_SUP_OK -> old driver. Equating these distinct nets creates a startup deadlock.

scenarios.title: Normal two-phase sequence retains route intent through an allocated 200us gap

checks.claim: first admitted phase closes the common guard command
normal request end immediately consumes per-phase block and opens all guards
normal timer completion does not latch timeout or discard global arm
explicit phase rearm admits opposite phase while route intent remains held

limitations: Polarity capture is the old driver's separately bound function; this supervisor model never generates an opposite pulse. A 200us gap is a provisional engineering allocation and the model waits explicit qualified quiet plus secondary-low; the older 100us schedule is unearned under the selected RC/threshold/latency corners.

scenarios.title: Early end and repeated request cannot reopen the same phase window

checks.claim: timer stays active but consumed BLOCK prevents reopening
rearm cannot clear block while request remains high

limitations: The phase-rearm level must be released before request. This is an admitted sequencing rule, not qualified glitch immunity.

scenarios.title: Primary timer stuck high is interrupted by the separately triggered secondary timer

checks.claim: secondary interval is still admitted before its own deadline
secondary expiry independently opens guards, latches timeout and removes global arm
timeout remains sticky rather than resuming

limitations: SET-open is conservatively represented by an injected primary timer stuck-high witness, not a manufacturer-defined SET-open transfer. 264us is the separate conservative analogue timing allocation before physical guard delay.

scenarios.title: host_rails_ok loss interrupts both sources; recovery does not resume

checks.claim: global health loss opens the common eighteen-port guard command
restored observation alone cannot resume either request

scenarios.title: afe_blank_observed loss interrupts both sources; recovery does not resume

checks.claim: global health loss opens the common eighteen-port guard command
restored observation alone cannot resume either request

scenarios.title: guard_fault_n loss interrupts both sources; recovery does not resume

checks.claim: global health loss opens the common eighteen-port guard command
restored observation alone cannot resume either request

scenarios.title: Reference failure is a retained observer-boundary witness

checks.claim: reference failure is not silently credited as an implemented health input
healthy-looking observers can leave an admitted phase despite reference failure

limitations: UNPROTECTED witness: no independent reference-window fault flag is wired into native SENSE_HEALTH. MON_VREF/MON_VMID tolerances and intact observer behaviour are explicit assumptions; corrupt reference/current/voltage sensing can mislead admission.

scenarios.title: Monitor permit loss is separate from supervisor and monitor rearm

checks.claim: monitor fault removes global raw health and arm
supervisor rearm does not clear independent monitor permission
monitor recovery alone cannot resume an interrupted phase

scenarios.title: Pair-terminal limit observes voltage independently of DAC and RUN

checks.claim: terminal observation loss inhibits even though request and RUN stay high
voltage recovery never reopens output automatically

limitations: The sensor is connected across internal driver A_BR/B_BR; this is neither tissue voltage nor physical mux-position readback. Window tolerance and differential-amplifier common-mode mismatch are retained separately.

scenarios.title: Raw supervisory rearm cannot acquire an edge when quiet returns

checks.claim: nonquiet observation rejects rearm despite low REQUEST/RUN
returning quiet cannot generate a raw rearm edge
fresh qualified edge rearms

scenarios.title: Timeout clear needs separate quiet FAULT_RESET and SUP_REARM

checks.claim: active request rejects timeout clearing
SUP_REARM cannot clear timeout itself
FAULT_RESET clears timeout but does not automatically arm
ordered separate reset/rearm removes deadlock

scenarios.title: Heartbeat watchdog timeout is much slower than phase duration limit

checks.claim: fresh heartbeat makes initial watchdog-good
missed heartbeat clears seen and arm
watchdog recovery does not fabricate first-edge evidence
fresh edge restores heartbeat evidence but not global arm

limitations: 170..230ms watchdog tolerance is not a microsecond pulse limiter or proof of correct firmware execution; falling edges can be generated by faulty firmware/peripherals.

scenarios.title: Shared power leaves Boolean model unqualified

checks.claim: valid warning first opens guards
invalid-supply outputs are unknown rather than falsely safe
recovery begins inhibited

limitations: Power generation and rail-off analogue terminal isolation are not implemented by this ideal event model; common power can defeat comparator, timer, latch and switch logic.

scenarios.title: Dual timer stuck-high remains a preserved failure witness

checks.claim: dual timer fault can leave an overlong admitted request

limitations: UNPROTECTED witness: primary and secondary timers can fail together; a healthy millisecond heartbeat does not impose a microsecond limit. 3mA x500us=1500nC is bookkeeping, not a simulated delivered-charge result.

scenarios.title: False-quiet, welded AFE switch and stuck guard are not certified away

checks.claim: healthy-looking voltage/blank observation can admit despite unobserved welded switch
commanded guard opens after a reported fault

limitations: UNPROTECTED witness: the AFE physical pin windows plus local blank commands do not prove every HV disconnect is unwelded. A welded source switch can remain connected while an RHD ground clamp keeps its pin inside the voltage window.
UNPROTECTED witness: a guard stuck conducting does not obey guard_command=0. Leakage, coupling, bypass paths and stored electrode charge are not equal to Boolean guard state.
UNPROTECTED witness: a failed current observer can assert quiet despite nonzero unobserved current. The model does not claim to diagnose that failure from REQUEST or RUN.

scenarios.title: One source timeout removes the common guard for both sources

checks.claim: source0 timeout removes shared ARM and both ALLOWs

limitations: All eighteen body-facing guards share one enable; fault interruption affects both sources. It does not automatically balance either interrupted phase.

scenarios.title: Request/timer coincidence cannot earn deterministic timeout classification

checks.claim: timeout classification retained unknown while output remains inhibited

limitations: The 2ns exclusion is a diagnostic scenario choice, not a qualified DFF metastability aperture or propagation specification.
